name: Trim Stain Cleanup — Template
intent: Final inspect + touchup on the trim substrate after stain finish. No room-level teardown tasks (those are absorbed into the stain protection lifecycle elsewhere). Extended by per-substrate MOD_CLEANUP_<substrate>_STAIN modules.
doctrine: Stain side defaults height:false (uniform across all 14 trim substrates). Inspection of cured stain is a stand-and-look operation; height differences haven't been calibrated separately on the stain side and are deliberately treated as no-op. If field data ever shows otherwise, override per-substrate.
